text:
anya: Canary (indigo15b-int4) deployed ~1h. Early signals: p95 token latency spike and memory fragmentation after sustained QPS (~2k for 3m).
leo: paste canary config?
anya: config:
```json
{"batching": {"min_batch":2, "max_batch":24, "max_new_tokens":256}, "prefetch": {"enabled": true, "slots":2, "balancer":"round_robin"}, "eviction": {"threshold_pct":70}}
```
sasha: hypotheses: prefetch slots + round_robin causing slot hotness mismatch -> KV churn; max_new_tokens=256 leads to large KV growth for session-style prompts.
jamie: infra traces show repeated evict + immediate re-prefetch at ~90s, slab allocator spikes.
infra-bot: Canary report: 3/10 nodes degraded, GPU mem 73%-91%, p95 tokens 180ms -> 420ms.
leo: can we repro? anya share driver.
anya: repro loop (curl):
```bash
for i in {1..200}; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/generate -d '{"model":"indigo15b-int4","prompt":"<long convo>","max_new_tokens":240}' & done
```
sasha: quick mitigations to test: set max_new_tokens=96, switch balancer->"slot_health", prefetch.slots=1.
jamie: also bump eviction.threshold_pct to 85 and enable low-priority slot_compactor to compact between requests.
anya: tested changes: after 20m p95 410ms -> 185ms, avg GPU mem ~68%, no node OOMs in canary window.
leo: queued eval job for long-form quality (job q-7822).
sasha: add telemetry: per_session_kv_bytes and slot_reuse_rate so we can tune balancer.
jamie: include allocator arena snapshots in next canary push to correlate slab fragmentation with KV churn.
anya: updated rollout policy, attaching logs https://s3.redwood/internal/canary/indigo15b/1759876543/logs.tar.gz :thumbsup:
